title: Where the Level Lock HomeKit code is
description: Level publishes no page on where its code is printed. Owners report the back of the quick start guide, and the underside of the original Level Lock.
lede: Level is the one brand here without a maker page to cite. What follows is what owners report, marked as such.

rows.term: Level Bolt and Level Lock Plus
rows.text: Owners and reviews put the HomeKit code on the back of the quick start guide. Level's support site had no article on it when checked.
Reported on the underside of the lock body.
Level's app release notes list Matter over Thread setup. Whether the app shows a Matter code is not documented. If your lock is in the Level app, look in its settings before resetting anything.
